answer: A mint needs k witnesses answering one beacon at one vertex: the registry flashes a fresh beacon, and applicant plus k witnesses sign it against the same vertex, one block hash, in that block. The k-th identity under one funding source needs k witnesses, drawn by lot, one co-sign each per epoch, each staking $50, slashed if fake; each slot costs one jade, $30, by registry rule. New rails cost $50 and a week each, the k-th of one person k times $50. 1,000 puppets need 1+2+…+1,000 witnesses — 500,500 jades, $15,015,000; an honest applicant needs one witness, one jade, $30 once.
